note: Data of Eindil's journey: the stage table (floors as engine dates at the standard story pace; the module writes the three pace sets), tuning constants (script constants, integers), spirits, traits, opinion modifiers, decisions, the stage names for the interface, the rule text, and the text of the events the mechanic owns. Scripts live in the module. The 30-odd narrative events of namespace zin_eindil (ids 10 to 169) belong to events_eindil.mjs and are not defined here.

stages.name: The Man in the Ice
stages.desc: Hunters cutting a path across the old ice have found a man inside it, and he breathes.

stages.name: The Road South
stages.desc: He travels with the traders of the West Lands, and keeps three promises on the way.

stages.name: The War-King
stages.desc: A truce breaks at a grey ford, and a stranger is asked to stand between two armies.

stages.name: The Storm
stages.desc: He sails for the old kingdom, and the sea carries him somewhere else.

stages.name: Gala
stages.desc: In the oldest court of the living, a king who remembers Dardan speaks with him for weeks.

stages.name: The Voyage North
stages.desc: A ship like no other goes north through the ice with a mixed crew, and the ports it passes take notice.

stages.name: Yeldenne
stages.desc: Snow, a quiet shore, and a castle with one lamp lit.

stages.name: The Warnings
stages.desc: He tells the courts what is coming. Some of them listen.

stages.name: The Return
stages.desc: A dragon comes down on the field.

stages.name: The Cliff
stages.desc: A brother's blade, and a road above a gorge.

stages.name: The Palace
stages.desc: Armies cannot take the palace of Parim. One man and his friends may go in.

stages.name: Crowned
stages.desc: The crown of Aenor is offered, and the Fourth Age turns.

spirits.name: The Stranger Among Us
spirits.desc: A tall man works at our fires and asks no pay. The hunters watch him; the children follow him; no one has yet asked what he is.

spirits.name: A Restless Guest
spirits.desc: We would not let him go, and he has not forgotten. The halls are quieter than they were.

spirits.name: Burned Granaries
spirits.desc: The bridge held, and the grain did not. The stranger saved what he could, and the rest was ash.

spirits.name: The Stranger's Judgment
spirits.desc: A stranger asked only that the law be the same for him as for any man. The lawspeakers have not forgotten the lesson.

spirits.name: The War-King's Banner
spirits.desc: For one season our captains march beneath a borrowed banner and a stranger's name.

spirits.name: The War-King's Peace
spirits.desc: Two old enemies ate at one table at the ford. Neither wishes to be the first to break the bread.

spirits.name: Shunned at the Ford
spirits.desc: The crowns of the confederation will not meet our envoys while the war-king's peace stands refused.

spirits.name: The Sea Went Silent
spirits.desc: The drowned voices on the reef fell quiet the night a stranger swam out and brought the children back.

spirits.name: The Warning Heeded
spirits.desc: We were told what was coming and we did not laugh. Our watchtowers are manned and our levies counted.

spirits.name: The Host of the Heir
spirits.desc: Aenoran survivors, frontier captains and strangers from across the sea ride under one banner and the heir's name.

spirits.name: The Heir Has Fallen
spirits.desc: The champion lies on the field and the line wavers. Each captain looks to the next.

spirits.name: They Say the King Is Dead
spirits.desc: The rumour ran faster than the riders. Half the host believes it.

spirits.name: The Palace Holds
spirits.desc: The service passages ran with blood, and the false king's wards held. The rebels in the palace have gone quiet.

spirits.name: First Friends of the King
spirits.desc: Those who fed the stranger, mended his ship or opened a gate to him are remembered at the court of Parim.

unitLeaderTraits.name: The Man from the Ice
unitLeaderTraits.desc: He came out of the ice warm. Cold has not troubled him since.

unitLeaderTraits.name: The King Without a House
unitLeaderTraits.desc: He was a war-king for one season, and laid the crown on a table when the peace was made.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Heir of Aen
unitLeaderTraits.desc: Lorien named him son of Ein, and what he had forgotten came back to him as weight.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Alone in the Snow
unitLeaderTraits.desc: Every man who sailed with him lies behind in the white. He walks on with their names.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Bearer of Glo
unitLeaderTraits.desc: The green light beats at his breast. The sword of the guardian is in his hand.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Struck Down
unitLeaderTraits.desc: The southern lord's blast threw him to the ground. He has not yet risen.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Blessed of the New Gods
unitLeaderTraits.desc: The gods gathered round him on the field and gave what they could. Lightning stands in his eyes.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Grievously Wounded
unitLeaderTraits.desc: He fights on, and each step shows what it costs.

unitLeaderTraits.name: Maimed, Unbroken
unitLeaderTraits.desc: He lost an arm and a kingdom, and came back with a simpler sword and no fear of heights.

countryLeaderTraits.name: King Without a House
countryLeaderTraits.desc: He rules a host and no hall, and asks the captains only to stand together.

countryLeaderTraits.name: The Rightful King
countryLeaderTraits.desc: Aen's line is on the throne of Aenor again, and the crown rests lightly on a man who did not seek it.

countryLeaderTraits.name: Guest of Lorien
countryLeaderTraits.desc: The elder court gives him its oldest records and its patience.

categories.name: The Stranger's Road
categories.desc: A tall man is a guest in your hall. He will leave when his road calls him, whatever you decide.

categories.name: The Host of the Heir
categories.desc: The heir's host is raised. Strangers and old enemies ride under one banner, and each must be asked.

categories.name: The Palace of Parim
categories.desc: Armies cannot storm the palace. One man and a few friends may find the way in.

zin_eindil_ask_counsel.name: Ask the Stranger's Counsel
zin_eindil_ask_counsel.desc: The guest knows more than he remembers. An evening in his company steadies the court and the camp.

zin_eindil_speed_him_on.name: Speed Him On
zin_eindil_speed_him_on.desc: Give him a horse, a guide and a purse, and let his road take him. The court will not forget the courtesy.

zin_eindil_detain_him.name: Detain Him
zin_eindil_detain_him.desc: A great warrior at a small court is a prize. Keep him half a year more, and let the court bear what comes of it.

zin_eindil_swear_to_heir.name: Swear to the Heir
zin_eindil_swear_to_heir.desc: Pledge the realm's host to the stranger's cause. When he returns, your realm will be the one he raises.

zin_eindil_enforce_peace.name: Enforce the War-King's Peace
zin_eindil_enforce_peace.desc: The war-king's terms were refused. The confederation's crowns may close their roads to those who fight on.

zin_eindil_call_stranded.name: Call the Stranded Armies
zin_eindil_call_stranded.desc: Send word again to the soldiers who stayed behind in a foreign land. The heir does not ask them to kneel, only to stand together.

zin_eindil_find_passages.name: Find the Old Service Passages
zin_eindil_find_passages.desc: Parim's palace has passages the architects forgot and the cooks remember. Send scouts to ask.

zin_eindil_rally_rebels.name: Rally the Palace Rebels
zin_eindil_rally_rebels.desc: Servants, guardsmen and a few honest clerks stand ready inside the walls. Alleria knows whom to trust.

zin_eindil_rally_rebels_unaided.name: Rally the Palace Rebels, Unaided
zin_eindil_rally_rebels_unaided.desc: No friend of the heir knows the palace's servants. Gold and patience may buy what a name cannot.

zin_eindil_enter_palace.name: Enter the Palace
zin_eindil_enter_palace.desc: The passages are found and the rebels wait. Go in, and take the false king's gifts from him one by one.

journey.name: The Stranger's Road
journey.desc: How the realms in the stranger's way choose. Players always choose freely.

options.name: Follows the Historical Path
options.desc: The realms in the stranger's way choose as the Historical Path rule says.

options.name: As the Chronicle Tells It
options.desc: Realms in the stranger's way always take the choice the chronicle records. The road runs on time.

options.name: Every Realm Chooses
options.desc: Each realm in the stranger's way weighs its own interest. Kindness and cruelty both find hosts.

locExtra.zin_eindil_guest_of_lorien_desc: A tall stranger from the south sits at Lorien's table and listens to the oldest histories of the First Men.
